blocks.content: Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen
As you've already seen, this course builds on the portfolio we made in the Figma to Code course.
To get the most out of this course, you should be comfortable with HTML and CSS and know your way around Figma. If you aren't quite there yet, go through these courses first.

blocks.content: If you're already confident with all three, great, you're all set. But even if you are, I'd still recommend going through the Figma to Code course first.
The portfolio code will feel a lot more familiar when we start changing it, trust me on this one.
